steps.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=0 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 1<>0 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN -1<0 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 2>1 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=0 THEN N'a' END AS value
SELECT id,CASE WHEN id=1 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value FROM (VALUES(1),(2)) v(id) ORDER BY id
SELECT CASE WHEN id=1 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value FROM (VALUES(1)) v(id) WHERE 1=0
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 'a' ELSE 'longer' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS case_result,IIF(1=1,'a',N'longer') AS iif_result,COALESCE('a',N'longer') AS coalesce_result
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN N'a' ELSE 'longer' END AS case_result,IIF(1=1,N'a','longer') AS iif_result,COALESCE(N'a','longer') AS coalesce_result
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 'a' WHEN 1=0 THEN 'verylong' ELSE N'x' END AS case_result,COALESCE('a','verylong',N'x') AS coalesce_result

SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN '' ELSE N'x' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 'a' ELSE CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(12)) END AS case_result,IIF(1=1,'a',CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(12))) AS iif_result,COALESCE('a',CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(12))) AS coalesce_result
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(12)) ELSE N'🦆' END AS value
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN N'a' ELSE CAST(N'longer' AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) END AS value
SELECT IIF(1=1,N'a',N'longer') AS yes,IIF(1=0,N'a',N'longer') AS no
SELECT IIF(1<>0,N'a',N'longer') AS value
SELECT IIF(1=1,NULL,N'x') AS unicode_result,IIF(1=1,NULL,'abc') AS ansi_result
SELECT id,IIF(id=1,N'a',N'longer') AS value FROM (VALUES(1),(2)) v(id) ORDER BY id
SELECT IIF(1=1,CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(12)),N'🦆') AS bounded,IIF(1=1,N'a',CAST(N'longer' AS NVARCHAR(MAX))) AS unbounded
SELECT COALESCE(N'a',N'longer') AS short,COALESCE(NULL,N'longer') AS long,COALESCE(N'',N'🦆') AS empty
SELECT COALESCE(CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(12)),N'🦆') AS bounded,COALESCE(CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(MAX)),N'a') AS unbounded
SELECT id,COALESCE(CAST(v AS NVARCHAR(12)),N'🦆') AS value FROM (VALUES(1,N'a'),(2,NULL)) s(id,v) ORDER BY id
SELECT COALESCE('a','longer') AS short,COALESCE('','longer') AS empty
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN N'🦆' ELSE N'longer' END AS bird,IIF(1=1,N'',N'🦆') AS empty,COALESCE(N'🦆',N'a') AS pair
SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value UNION ALL SELECT N'xx'
SELECT CASE WHEN id=1 THEN N'a' ELSE N'longer' END AS value FROM (VALUES(1)) v(id) UNION ALL SELECT N'xx'
